stages.grand: Edit the concept. stages.mythic: Edit the concept and go much further: much bigger, taller and far more sumptuous, as if a whole rich land had spent much more money and labour on it. Keep the same well: round stepped stone rim, the great beam arm between two stone piers, the straight rope with a bucket, the iron-caged block, the lanterns, the oak chest, the plank with the wheel. Build it up: a broad terrace of fine cut stone with a carved balustrade on two sides and wide stairs, four tall carved stone piers (two carrying the beam), a mast beam almost twice as long that rises steeply to the top of the picture, with the rope falling straight from its tip into the well, an enormous cage holding a broken grey-blue opaque block of glacier ice with a dark rock inside, held by heavy iron chains, many lanterns on the balustrade posts, a stone trough with a gutter to the rim. Strong cold magic, clear by day and by night: thick white frost over the top of the beam, the piers and the terrace, white frosted grass on the ground patch, drops falling from the ice into the gutter, a cold blue-white glow in the ice and at the bottom of the hole. There is no flag pole and no cloth anywhere: no banner, no hanging fabric. The only sign is a small stiff carved wooden pennant board fixed on a short post at the corner of the terrace. Nobody in the image, no people at all. Footprint unchanged, growth goes up and stays inside the canvas. No letters or runes, no hanging cloth, no hard-edged slab, no painted cast shadow, no fog patches, no sheet of grey smoke. Matte, no gloss, no gilding.
